summary: Comprehensive architectural revision plan for the Kinetic Live Filter Switcher across all 16 business verticals in Atrium ERP & CRM. Incorporates the user's confirmed design decisions: dual deployment on both dashboard period filters and collection status bars, integrated numerical count badges with real-time color-mix cross-fading, adaptive height profiles (34px dashboard / 30px collection toolbar), and exact mathematical dual-spring physics matching Atrium.dc.html.
